name: Rimac Campus production facility, Kerestinec
products: electric powertrain and automotive technology hardware

sources.evidence: Rimac's current Campus page identifies a 70,000-square-metre production facility in Sveta Nedelja/Kerestinec for electric hypercars and automotive technology; current Rimac careers pages state that production operators at Campus Kerestinec build battery systems and hardware for Rimac and partner vehicles.
Rimac's current Production Operator Campus page states that teams at Campus Kerestinec develop and produce hardware for the Nevera and other automotive manufacturers' vehicles.
Latvijas Finieris' current official production page lists Lignums in Riga as a plywood mill and its production matrix shows veneer and plywood production at the mill.

Alvotech's current manufacturing page identifies a multiproduct biomanufacturing facility in Reykjavik, Iceland, inaugurated in June 2016, with GMP clinical/commercial manufacturing and aseptic fill-and-finish lines for vials and prefilled syringes.
Alvotech's May 11, 2026 official release confirms the Reykjavik manufacturing facility remained under active cGMP surveillance and operation following an FDA inspection completed May 8, 2026.

Sunlight Group's current official Industrial Complex page identifies Xanthi, Greece as a flagship manufacturing site with fully automated lithium-ion and lead-acid lines, eight production lines, a 90,000 m2 footprint and 9 GWh annual capacity.

Medochemie's current official manufacturing-sites page states that nine of its fifteen production sites are in Cyprus and identifies the AZ Oral Facility in Cyprus as capable of producing and packing two billion tablets and 300 million capsules per year.
